notes.title: Update 08.05.2025
notes.notes:
Minor corrections:

[olist]

notes.title: Update 04.05.2025
notes.notes:

[olist]

notes.title: Update 03.05.2025
notes.notes:
Small changes:

[olist]
[*] Added game icon!
[*] Fixed: AI continued to attack a killed player!
[*] The shop now displays your money in the BUY RESOURCES section!

notes.title: Update 02.05.2025
notes.notes:
What's changed:

[olist].
[*] “QUICK PLAY” was not working! Fixed!
[*] The boss at the location “Bunker” is now immortal during the battle cry, as well as invulnerable to explosions!
[*] Balanced loot drop from killed enemies!
[*] AIs now spawn more often at the location “Bunker” during the activation of the terminal!

notes.title: Update 01.05.2025!
notes.notes:
After a long time, I decided to completely redesign the bunker map to make the gameplay more comfortable!

What's changed:

[olist]
[*] The map “Bunker” is completely redesigned! 
[*] Added FOV adjustment in settings!
[*] Made a new display of the current task on the map Bunker!
[*] Made a shop indicator that appears when the shop is open!
[*] Changed the color of some panels!
[*] Added display of available points for player improvements to the upper right corner!
[*] Added a boss at the Bunker location! 
[*] Now you only need to activate 3 terminals and defeat the boss for evacuation to become available!
[*] Fixed a bug that prevented players from evacuating!
[*] Fixed a bug that made player speed and AI speed dependent on FPS!
[*] Improved player and AI movement, now they move, turn, and replicate much better!
[*] Location “Trenches” is temporarily inaccessible now, it is also being reworked!
[*] Improved AI behavior!
[*] Added “Quick Play” button in the menu, for quick match search!
[*] Added new achievements for killing the boss at the “Bunker” location!
[*] Optimized many textures and materials on the location “Bunker”!
[*] Balanced AI spawn on the location “Bunker”!
[*] Terminals on the location “Bunker” now correctly display the load percentage!
[/olist]

Now I am actively engaged in game development, creating new AI, weapons and much more! Thank you for taking part in the game development!

notes.title: Update 22.12.2024
notes.notes:
The game has moved to the new version of Unreal Engine 5.5!

Thank you for supporting the project, I try to develop it in my free time, but so far I have too much work and do not have time to finish the new location!

New Year is coming soon, I wish you to spend it with a great mood and with your friends or family! 
Let's wish each other success, achievements and that all dreams come true, and in the whole incredibly big universe there was always peace and order :)

notes.title: Update 02.12.2024
notes.notes:
Tactical Zone now uses Unreal Engine 5.5! I've been working for a long time to improve performance and fix critical bugs!

[list]
[*] Player and AI now use Asynchronous physics and their movement speed is no longer dependent on frame rate (FPS)!
[*] Improved AI vision, now they can more accurately detect a target to attack!
[*] Fixed the camera while the player is crouching, it no longer jerks and is slightly higher!
[*] Clones now try to aim for enemies' heads!
[*] Fixed a performance issue with a large number of enemies!
[*] Critical damage hitbox has been fixed and is now easier to hit!
[*] Other small changes to optimize the game!
[/list]

notes.title: Changes 11.09.2024
notes.notes:
- The “Trench” map has been changed!
- Data is now sent longer with each activation on the “Trenches” map
- Fixed AI logic!
- Added snipers to the “Trenches” map
- Improved shooting system!
- Fixed when a grenade was thrown instead of a flyer!
- Fire grenades now burns only on flat surfaces!
- Fixed sound volume not changing!
- Terminals on the location “Bunker” now take longer to activate!
- Laser sight is now more accurate!

notes.title: Hotfix 10.09.2024
notes.notes:
- Fixed: AIs not appearing on Bunker location!
- Fixed: game lagged during grenade explosion!
- Improved: Now registration of hits became more accurate and in 99% you will hit where you shoot! Regardless of ping!
- New HUD with HP and ARMOUR, as well as now displays the number of kills!
- Fixed when the game was crashing while installing equipment (Clones, Turrets, Drones).

Also partially improved locations, now on the location Trenches new music during the battle, as well as some gameplay changes!

notes.title: Update 0.006
notes.notes:
- fixed: AIs did not attack the activated terminal at the "Bunker" location.
- now players cannot pass through each other.
- added new indicators to help players better understand the mission objective.
- improved the code of indicators, which will slightly improve performance.
- AI on the "Trenches" location has been changed and now looks different.

notes.title: Update 0.005
notes.notes:
Now I am working hard on a new location, as well as Bosses for the location "Bunker" and "Trenches", soon they will appear in the game! 

Here is a small list of changes that should fix the main problems with the game:

- fixed leaderboard.
- fixed: skill points are not awarded at the "Trenches" location after the terminal is activated.
- improved AI movement replication, now they move more smoothly and are easier to hit.
- changed the effect of grenade explosion.
- fixed: double triggering of interaction with objects.
- partially changed the interface in the menu.
- fixed: AIs would sometimes stop turning after losing sight of the player.
